verdict.limitations: The assessment is based solely on the provided frontal and lateral chest radiographs. Subtle abnormalities may not be detectable on plain radiographs. Clinical context and prior imaging, if available, would provide additional valuable information for a comprehensive evaluation. The provided images are plain radiographs, which have inherent limitations in detecting subtle abnormalities compared to cross-sectional imaging. Overlying structures can obscure pathology. The images are not compared to prior studies, which could help identify interval changes.
